name: Altered Studio
summary: A comprehensive voice content creation platform integrating multiple Voice AI technologies, including speech-to-speech voice morphing, into a user-friendly application.
description:
A comprehensive voice content creation platform integrating multiple Voice AI technologies, including speech-to-speech voice morphing, into a user-friendly application.

Altered Studio's unique technology allows you to change your voice to any of its carefully curated AI voices to create compelling professional voice-driven performances.

AI audio processing: Altered Studio supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
